description: The member's OWN availability for a date window. GigXchange is free-by-default: they are bookable on every date EXCEPT the marked ones this returns (unavailable / soft_hold / confirmed_booking). Default window 90 days, max 365.

from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 90 days after "from"; capped at 365.

name: my_availability
title: My availability calendar
